name: Welcome to Wimblewick
source: One day, Ryo is informed that he’ll have to move to Wimblewick Isle. And while the place isn’t too far from his city, you could say some of the people there have a little...  extra charm to them.
translation: 有一天，亮被告知他必须搬到温布尔威克岛。虽然这个地方离他的城市不太远，但你可以说那里的一些人对他们来说有一点……额外的魅力。
